name: aeropad
description: Local-first RFC 6238 2FA and encrypted-at-rest security workbench

scripts.claims:check: node --input-type=module -e "import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs'; const pkg=JSON.parse(readFileSync('package.json','utf8')); const surfaces=[['README.md',readFileSync('README.md','utf8')],['package metadata',String(pkg.description)+' '+(pkg.keywords||[]).join(' ')]]; const banned=['zero-knowledge','apple-grade','decentralized','no data ever leaves the device']; const hits=[]; for (const [name,text] of surfaces) { const lower=text.toLowerCase(); for (const term of banned) if (lower.includes(term)) hits.push(name+': '+term); if (lower.includes('apple') && lower.includes('web3')) hits.push(name+': apple + web3'); } const policy=readFileSync('docs/SECURITY-AND-PRIVACY.md','utf8').toLowerCase(); for (const term of ['same-origin','encrypted at rest','aeropad does not upload vault content','no telemetry','backup']) if (!policy.includes(term)) hits.push('security docs missing: '+term); if (hits.length) { console.error(hits.join('; ')); process.exit(1); } console.log('claim policy: PASS');"
scripts.deploy: npm run build && npx wrangler deploy
